test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: maths
question: A sum of Rs. 5,000 is divided into two parts such that the simple interest the first part for 4(1)/(5)years at 6(2)/(3)% p.a. is double the simple interest on the second part for 2(3)/(4) years at 4% p.a. The ratio of the second part to the first part is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest factor for first part (R₁ × T₁) = (20/3)% × (21/5) = 28%.

Total interest factor for second part (R₂ × T₂) = 4% × (11/4) = 11%.

Given: Interest on first part = 2 × Interest on second part.

⇒ P₁ × 28% = 2 × (P₂ × 11%) ⇒ 28 P₁ = 22 P₂.

⇒ P₂/P₁ = 28/22 = 14/11.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 : 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Sum = ₹5,000

For First Part (P₁): Rate (R₁) = 20/3% p.a., Time (T₁) = 21/5 years.

For Second Part (P₂): Rate (R₂) = 4% p.a., Time (T₂) = 11/4 years.

Condition: SI₁ = 2 × SI₂

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4361f29aedf0abd4b0964844af3e34424f5dfceb8d32eb78c020c9b4fac6e0f1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI₁ = (P₁ × 20/3 × 21/5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₁ = (P₁ × 4 × 7) ÷ 100 = 28 P₁ / 100

⇒ SI₂ = (P₂ × 4 × 11/4) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = (P₂ × 11) ÷ 100 = 11 P₂ / 100

⇒ Since SI₁ = 2 × SI₂

⇒ 28 P₁ / 100 = 2 × (11 P₂ / 100)

⇒ 28 P₁ = 22 P₂

⇒ P₂ / P₁ = 28 / 22

⇒ P₂ / P₁ = 14 / 11

**∴ The correct answer is 14 : 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Simple interest is calculated only on the principal amount. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate, and T is Time.

Ratio of Principals

If interests on two parts are equal, P₁ : P₂ = (1 ÷ R₁T₁) : (1 ÷ R₂T₂). If SI₁ = n × SI₂, then P₁R₁T₁ = n × P₂R₂T₂.

Mixed Fraction Conversion

To convert a mixed fraction A b/c into an improper fraction, use (A × c + b) ÷ c. For example, 6 2/3 = (6×3 + 2)/3 = 20/3.
